name: hank
description: A security analyst for your Claude Code agentic OS. Scans CLAUDE.md, skills, .mcp.json, settings, and hooks for prompt injection, tool poisoning, leaked secrets, over-broad permissions, and risky hooks, mapped to the OWASP LLM Top 10 (2025), and hands back a meme-powered Security Report Card. Then trains you on what it found: Hank Academy is a gamified security quiz with XP, ranks, daily streaks, and badges that show up on your report card.
